scope: Train-only new 2500-query roles and sixteen new million-scale hnswlib graphs. Query-specific seven-source History-Max is an online information-acquisition policy, not zero-cost prediction for a query with no measured source history.
label: For each query/source graph, stable_tail is the smallest grid action for which all actions at or above it have exact Recall@10 >=0.95. If none, label BOT. Truth is exact against the newly frozen common base, with no formal HDF5 test role.
transport: For a target graph, use the maximum stable_tail among the other seven graphs on that same new query. If any source label is BOT, candidate is BOT and endpoint2400 is used. The target graph's own response is forbidden in its candidate computation.
selection: The 500 target_selection queries may describe cost and risk only; they cannot alter the grid, History-Max rule, target action, threshold, or fallback. No search over policies or seed exclusion.
certification: On 500 independent target_certification query IDs, first test fixed endpoint2400 with one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound on event Recall@10<0.95. If endpoint UCB>0.05 the target is undeployable. Otherwise test the candidate rule on the same cert role with a separate one-sided CP95 bound; accept candidate only if UCB<=0.05, else use fixed endpoint2400. This is descriptive conditional certification for eight registered graphs, not a global deployment guarantee. Failed graphs remain in denominators.
evaluation: On separate 1000 target_evaluation IDs, apply the locked target-level decision and per-query seven-source candidate without reading that target graph's evaluation response beforehand. Report exact recalled IDs, native distance counts, raw risk and mean cost, fallback/undeployable, and one-sided uncertainty. No negative-result tuning or same-key replay.
dependency_and_inference: Target build is the outer unit (eight per dataset). Queries and seven source directions are nested and shared; do not present 56 directions or 1000 query rows as independent graph replications. Report per-target rows and descriptive panel counts, plus crossed target-build x shared-query uncertainty if calculated.

lifecycle.resource_unit: one isolated CPU2 graph/profile/serving unit on the same machine; exact truth uses frozen CPU4-19/16-thread Faiss and is explicitly separated
required_components: raw HDF5 train read and new base membership
exact truth base acquisition and role-specific searches
balanced single-query serving including warm-up declaration
lifecycle.comparison: TCP versus same-target fixed endpoint2400. Count control's graph build/load and serving; count TCP's eight-graph build/load/storage, exact query truth, all source profiles, certification and serving. Give shared-campaign and per-target allocations separately; missing stages are MISSING, never zero.
lifecycle.amortization: Report measured component time and symbolic T_policy(Q,V) versus T_endpoint(Q,V), with Q distinct queries per deployment and V visits/query. A positive break-even is reported only if all charged components are observed and serving savings strictly positive. No E8 zero-fill.
lifecycle.cache_boundary: One process per graph/profile and balanced query/action order for serving. OS page-cache eviction is not authorized; label measured reload warm/unknown-cache, never cold-start. No concurrent build during formal timing.

original_e8: NOT_ESTIMABLE remains frozen and is not repaired by this new-key experiment.
stop_rules: Freeze all implementation and input SHA pins before target ANN response execution. Independent full ordered-ID/truth/recall/native-count audit and actual process waits are mandatory. A failure preserves all evidence and stops dependent work; no automatic same-key retry, outcome-based parameter choice, or substitution of an old index/role.
